entries.reason: the port has no MIDI-CI transport, so no MIDICIDevice is ever produced: every property answers the empty value (no MUID, no profiles, no supported capability; MIDIUMP18.m). The class is declared so that the manager's list type exists. On the measured host macOS lists none (oracle/umpclasses.m); a machine with a MIDI-CI device is not measured.
entries.effect: a MIDICIDevice cannot be obtained, and its properties are the empty values.

entries.reason: the port has no MIDI-CI transport, so no profile is ever listed on a device: every property answers the empty value, and setProfileState:enabledChannelCount:error: does nothing, answers NO and says so once in the log (charon_ci_inert, MIDIUMP18.m).
entries.effect: a profile is never listed, enabled or disabled.
